lambda_reference: Ratio of medians of per-path parameter-gradient norms at initialization on first32 fitting paths; exact-zero numerator or denominator uses mean abs fitting cost / (0.5*T*sum release_capacity^2)
derivative: Both u and x, including all moving recourse, differentiated; channel omissions affect backward graphs only
selection: Joint positive strength and original LR grid selected by validation operating cost separately within each SAME fitting budget and seed; initial checkpoint eligible; ties lower strength then original LR order
tuning_accounting: Three times original LR candidate count for most families, same unique fit paths; report total updates/runtime. Calibration32 fitting paths counted as additional gradient queries, not additional distinct data.
zero_controls: N1000 reruns for each architecture and benchmark; original zero results retained elsewhere; baseline methods unchanged
device: CPU, one thread per worker. Historical real-case baseline training used CUDA; no cross-era speed claim.
test: No held-out cost evaluated until all requested selection files are written; existing test/historical data reused for paired reporting, never for selection
channel_selection: Choose strength by full-gradient validation for each seed, then hold it identical in omitted-gradient variants; retain all exploratory candidates and charge their compute.
